scope: Read-only review of final un-deployed deterministic report; no scientific calls, report invocation, test invocation or rendering by reviewer.

resolved_findings.resolution: Every cross-host non-native wait now requires the exact wait and launch path/bytes/SHA pair indexed from verified CLOSED_ON_EXECUTION_HOST observation. Child/parent identities and hosts must match; same-host checks always re-read /proc. No remote PID is tested on local host.

Exact current phase, role, control and worker failure paths are inspected. Only the three specified analysis metadata roots can be allowed by explicit root descriptor also in zero-science exception evidence. Changed/unknown failure files and worker/control exceptions reject; evidence remains retained.

nonblocking_display_revision: Paired agreement label uses percentage points (pp), while original CSV fractions and confidence bounds remain unchanged.
checked_contracts: 27000 B2 logical objects, nine authorized candidates, 1000 sources with three noises, and four saved policies; no reselection.
1200 B3 frames including all failures, 400 source groups, 2800 metric source means, 28 marginal means, 14 direct paired intervals.
Source means and confidence intervals only read from pinned completed results; no metric model, channel, resampling, quantile or bootstrap call in report.
Zero, negative and cross-zero intervals retained; fixed-full 4/10 and fixed-full19 tables separate.
Actual paid 2x68 headers, 2x956 bodies, 26 length bits, 32 body-CRC bits,192 reassembly bits; source occupancy excludes these fields and uses byte-rounded registered capacity.
Native manifests, actual runtime identity member descriptors, source code pins, expected metric schemas and saved bootstrap SHA verified; actual source/pixel no model regeneration.
Existing fixed-reference delivery and metric files were read and matched to producer schemas; no nonexistent fixed schema fields found.
deployment_conditions: Root must bind actual final closed B2/B3 completion and exact runtime/outer receipt descriptors, including any reviewed metadata adapters. Do not substitute pending or forecast evidence.
All required scientific stages must actually exit0, no unknown failure, complete ledger and real host closure before report invocation.
Report rendering must have a real bounded child wait and all actual exported color/grayscale/PDF pages opened and checked; its pending review completion must not be treated as final visual approval.
Only reviewed exact engineering exceptions may be supplied; no blanket failure suppression or scientific retry authorization.
